# incusos_system_logging (Resource)

Manages IncusOS system logging configuration (`/1.0/system/logging`), including remote syslog and systemd-journal-upload.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `journal_upload` (Attributes) systemd-journal-upload remote server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--journal_upload))
- `syslog` (Attributes) Remote syslog server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--syslog))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--journal_upload"></a>
### Nested Schema for `journal_upload`

Required:

- `url` (String) Remote journal upload URL.

Optional:

- `tls_ca_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded TLS CA certificate.
- `tls_client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded TLS client certificate.
- `tls_client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded TLS client private key.


<a id="nestedatt--syslog"></a>
### Nested Schema for `syslog`

Required:

- `address` (String) Remote syslog server address (host:port).

Optional:

- `log_format` (String) Syslog message format.
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol (e.g., `tcp`, `udp`).
